en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Sa’alba Bin Maymoun, from Muhammad Bin Qays, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Loves the greeting (السَّلَامُ)’ offered openly (loudly).
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from Tha’Labah’ ibn Maymun from Muhammad ibn Qays from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, loves offering the greeting of peace openly, loud and clearly.”
